2:238.text: . And stand before Allâh with obedience
[and do not speak to others during the Salât (prayers)]

2:239.text: And when you are in safety, offer the Salât
in the manner He has taught you, which you knew not

2:240.text: And those of you who die and leave behind wives should bequeath for their wives a year’s maintenance and residence without turning them out, but if they
leave, there is no sin on you for that which they do of themselves, provided it is honourable

2:241.text: . This is a duty on Al-Muttaqûn

2:242.text: Thus Allâh makes clear His Ayât
to you, in order that you may understand.

2:243.text: not think of those who went forth from their homes in thousands, fearing death? Allâh said to them, "Die". And then He restored them to life. Truly, Allâh is full of bounty to mankind, but most men thank not.

2:244.text: And fight in the Way of Allâh and know that Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

2:245.text: Who is he that will lend to Allâh a goodly loan so that He may multiply it to him many times? And it is Allâh that decreases or increases
, and unto Him you shall return.
